title: Justin Joly drafted by Broncos, Brandon Cleveland headed to Raiders

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Justin Joly drafted by Broncos, Brandon Cleveland headed to Raiders
sources.description: Justin Joly and Brandon Cleveland had to wait a while to hear their names called during the NFL Draft, but finally found their landing spots on Saturday afternoon. Joly was taken by the Denver Broncos in the fifth round, at No. 152 overall. I was surprised he ended up falling that far into the field, […]
